title: design-package-overlay/v1 — importer-reconstructed description of a historical cut (docs/design/manifests/<dir>.overlay.yaml)
description: HANDOFF-LEGO-PIPE-024-R1 contract. A reconstruction is NOT a manifest (026 R-09 / 025 Q3): the designer cannot retro-sign bytes it did not export, so historical cuts (H-01 R0, H-01 R1 as-reviewed, H-01 R1 as-committed) get this distinct type, bound to {package_path, tree_sha256}, carrying field-level sources and evidence strength. A file bearing manifest_origin: designer found in docs/design/manifests/ is an ERROR — a designer manifest outside the verbatim bytes did not come from the designer. path_base is meaningless in a file that lives outside the tree it describes and is absent here; path_prefix_strip is declared data valid ONLY in this schema (025 R-12).

tree_sha256.x-note: Digest of the described tree per design-package-import/v1 x-tree-digest-spec. This binding is what makes the overlay's claims falsifiable: recompute and compare.

path_prefix_strip.x-note: Deterministic prefix removed when resolving the historical index.json's structured paths (H-01: 'handoff/' — the RULE for 86 of 102 paths, not a fallback; 025 R-12). Valid only in overlays; a designer manifest with the same mistake fails preflight.

archive_sha256_claimed.x-note: A register-cited historic archive digest preserved as a CLAIM (e.g. the 014-R0 row's e898a64a… for the as-reviewed cut). Never presented as verified: the archives are gone; corroboration prose lives in reconstruction.corroboration.

known_defects.x-note: For historical cuts the D-1…D-6 ids come from HANDOFF-LEGO-PIPE-019-R0 §4.2 — a memo, not the package (the package's own known_defects_open is two prose sentences without ids). 019 §4.2 must therefore appear in reconstruction.sources (025 R-02 / Q3).

fixtures.x-note: null for historical cuts — fixture seeding starts at cut R2 (023-R2 F5).

reconstruction.x-note: sources[] names every document the reconstructed facts came from; corroboration (free text) is where 'folders received unzipped; identity corroborated by file count, size and content diff' belongs — never in a digest field (025 R-23).

evidence.x-note: Map of overlay field name → {source, strength}. strength enum: measured (recomputed from bytes in this repo), corroborated (consistent with independent records), declared (asserted by a cited document), unknown.
